title: Reuse the actual numerical CRT bank across changing precision
body:
The actual CRT RowEntry retired its63 owned ports successfully but allocated a fresh physical bank for the next numerical context. This package reopens the unchanged caller on the same63 backing objects across arbitrary admitted precision changes, with paid marker reinstatement and unique live-result ownership. It leaves the arithmetic producer and source transport unchanged.

The proof derives each role's written extent from the actual source and explains why longer blank tails preserve delimiter-driven arithmetic. It gives a call-count-independent bound using rolewise historical maxima plus supplied initial blank capacity. Actual P6→P15→P6 calls retain536→1238→1238 cells with physical constructors sealed. A concrete counterexample has two P6 calls each using536 fresh cells but537 together, so maximum-of-standalone totals is unsound.

Normal/optimized, Git-free replay, seven lifecycle/history controls, source/typed-receipt corruption controls, committed bytes/source ancestry and22-file export integrity pass. The exact current-child P15 discriminator returns lower11 and offsets(0,3). The full old tails, all borrowed words and all role identities are checked.

This is successful source-operation owner reuse, not input production, arbitrary dirty-work acquisition, failure rollback, complete physical ROM/level integration, binary arithmetic lowering, or an outer multiplication theorem. No h4ROM replay or selected-frontier/kappa change. General historical-capacity accounting is credited to prior work, including PR5286's separate15-role interchange owner.

JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; retains Ali Romman's actual RowEntry and all numerical/CRT predecessor credit. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4709#discussioncomment-19173367
